intro: Measured on one machine (Windows 11, Intel 13900K, RTX 4090) against a retail Xbox Series 1.0.2.1 package. Every row below is an outcome the project produces, not a plan; the commands that produce them are in the Build section, and the failures behind each number are in docs/boot_frontier.md.

stages.evidence: the title's PE32+ image maps at its preferred base, imports resolve through shims, static TLS is redirected for 53,246 slot-0 reads, heap and file system come from the host
26,616 SPIR-V modules indexed; the pipeline library and FPSX repair are part of the build, and the boot loads 27,890 translated entries with 0 pipeline failures

device, queues, fences, allocators, descriptor heaps, command lists and pipelines answer; the console queue's two-method slot shift, the A8 render-target format and the fence completed-value address are measured and mapped
factory, file open, zlib decompression; BCPack and swizzled reads still refuse rather than guess
the title boots and runs its own loop for at least 400 s with no exception (5.2M traced D3D12 calls in 300 s), after the fence slot 12 answer
the loop iterates, but its command lists arrive already closed and it never executes or resets them
console PresentX (queue slot 32) still refuses with E_NOTIMPL, once per frame iteration
nothing is executed on the GPU yet, so nothing can be drawn

counts.what: D3D12 calls in a retail boot
Refused graphics pipeline creations (console slot 57, before the conversion)
Slot-57 calls per boot (deserialized graphics records)
Fence completed-value answers in one run

frontier.stop: none - the title runs (ALIVE 400 s, no exception)
frontier.summary: the title now boots into its own frame loop and keeps running: the fence's completed-value address (console fence slot 12) was the last boot-chain refusal. The frontier is now presentation: PresentX (console queue slot 32) is refused once per iteration, and each iteration's two command lists come back already closed - there is no command-list Reset and no ExecuteCommandLists anywhere in the boot, so nothing is recorded, executed or presented.

next: find why the frame's command lists are already closed (no Reset, no ExecuteCommandLists in the whole boot)
implement console PresentX (queue slot 32) - the one call the frame loop makes and we refuse
convert slot-57 records into real pipelines, now needed for the draws the lists never record
